verdict.rationale: Drata offers a programmatic Public API v2 with OAuth setup and write endpoints, such as creating policies, custom connections and devices. Its docs also describe custom triggers/actions and automated evidence collection. Together these allow headless automation from scripts or pipelines. However, the evidence never documents a CLI, CI integration, or pipeline-oriented auth such as service tokens, so CI use means hand-rolling API calls. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI plugin/action, documented CI/pipeline usage patterns, service-account/non-interactive auth guidance, and hands-on corroboration of headless runs.
